mutationEvidence: The first broad qualification instrumented 320 owner/authority mutants and exposed missing distinctions for already-unique selection, explicit unowned bindings, already-hoisted defaults, later-occurrence selection, instance-target remapping and key freshness.

After adding those independent consumer partitions, the final exact-source semantic scope killed 224 of 233 mutants; the authoritative groupRuntimeBindings/materialization seam killed all 35 of 35 selected mutants.

The nine reported survivors were refusal-message text, owner-label text, a discriminated-union branch equivalent after the preceding Clip-target branch, and runtime-shape guards whose mutated paths reached the same refusal. No runtime identity, payload authority, hoist, reference-remap, plan-completeness or affected-set semantic mutant survived.
